text: Testing plays a key role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of code, while integration tests make sure different parts work together correctly. Many developers use test-driven development, where they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach may feel slow at first, but it helps catch problems early. When tests are in place, developers feel more confident about making changes, because they know the tests will notice any mistakes. In short, good testing saves time, reduces stress, and leads to better, more reliable software.
